name: VusionGroup
summary: VusionGroup S.A. delivers sophisticated digitalization tools for commercial environments across Europe, Asia, and North America. The company's offerings span a range of Internet of Things (IoT) hardware, including electronic shelf labels, various cameras (such as Captana wireless mini cameras), associated fixtures and accessories, foundational infrastructure, and Wi-Fi integration systems. Complementing its hardware, VusionGroup provides a comprehensive suite of retail IoT Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions. These include platforms like VUSION Cloud, VUSION Asset Management, VUSION Manager, VUSION Studio, VUSION Link, VUSION Engage, Storefront, VUSION Rail, and VUSION Ads, tailored to support brands. Furthermore, its cloud platform capabilities are designed to facilitate pricing automation, enhance shelf efficiency, improve the in-store shopping experience for customers, provide marketing functionalities, and manage VUSION operating systems. VusionGroup's solutions are employed across numerous industries, such as grocery, fresh produce, electronics, DIY and furniture retail, pharmacies, cosmetics, fashion, digital signage, and general industrial sectors. Founded in 1992 and headquartered in Nanterre, France, the company was formerly known as SES-imagotag Société Anonyme, adopting the VusionGroup S.A. name in January 2024.
